comment: M50 gates registry — governance (G1) checks every entry exists, is wired into the verify chain, and that non-infra gates carry a falsifiability mutation used by the gate self-test. Probes are listed separately: they MEASURE (and may legitimately show a slow number) while gates DECIDE.

unregisteredIssues.A5: Registered after delivery as #788 once connectivity returned; the issue text was stored verbatim in docs/m50/A5-issue.md while the network was down, and the number was never invented before registration.

gates.mutation: strip sqlite_stat1 and drop the owner index, then prove the planner falls back to a full scan
remove one alias from the table and prove the family call is rejected again
truncate the blob column and prove reads still answer from JSON without throwing
corrupt the project-scope LOC aggregate (+1) and prove P5a fails
drop the bounded slice in testGaps and prove the returned page is no longer the oracle's top-K
inject a ghost tool name and delete a registry row; both must fail the gate
replay the A1 failure shapes; any shape that still fails to resolve must fail the gate
restore the pre-repair baseline shape (11 tools) in a copy and prove the contract gate reports drift
